entries.title: Shopify connection page.
entries.notes: Capture as an authorized admin with Shopify Commerce enabled. Use safe demo credentials/state; never expose real Shopify access tokens.
entries.useCase: An administrator connects or reviews the Shopify store connection for a Capell site.

entries.title: Shopify catalog sync state.
entries.notes: Capture after seeding a demo connection with sync status, product count, and last sync timestamps.
entries.useCase: An operator checks whether the local product catalog is connected and recently synced.

entries.title: Shopify product search.
entries.notes: Capture local catalog search with seeded demo products. Product data should be fake or fixture data, not a real merchant catalog.
entries.useCase: An editor searches synced Shopify products from inside Capell Admin.
